sources.title: Deep Research preview: exact agent specifications
sources.evidence: Labels the exact identifier an Interactions API agent code; specifies 1,048,576 input tokens, text/image/PDF/audio/video inputs, and cited text/image outputs.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: April 21, 2026 explicitly releases deep-research-preview-04-2026 and the separate Max version. October 8 migration guidance still names both April agents as successors to the December agent.

sources.title: Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents
sources.evidence: Dated April 21 launch distinguishes the speed-oriented Deep Research agent from Max. Names Gemini 3.1 Pro as the research model and HTML or Nano Banana for visualizations; describes research, citations and MCP tools.

sources.title: Gemini Deep Research agent guide
sources.evidence: Exact-ID examples document collaborative planning, intermediate reasoning summaries, generated images, search, URL Context, code execution, File Search and remote MCP. The limitations section excludes custom function-calling tools. This is a managed workflow using underlying Gemini models.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is governed by proprietary service terms; extraction or replication of underlying models and parameter weights is prohibited. The documentation page copyright licenses are not weight licenses.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro model card
sources.evidence: The announced research backbone is based on Gemini 3 Pro and explicitly delegates architecture details to that model card. Lists API/product distribution and performance comparisons, but no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: The later card explicitly describes sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture and identifies Gemini 3.1 Pro among its derivatives. It does not provide production parameter counts or define an architecture for the complete Deep Research agent.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card, October 2026
sources.evidence: Later first-party card compares safety results with Gemini 3.1 Pro but supplies no total/active parameter counts for that model or this Deep Research agent. Its own architecture is not attributed to the April agent.

sources.title: Models.dev exact agent record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead provides the display name and gemini-pro grouping and links to the primary agent specification, guide and launch announcement. Technical claims were checked against those primary sources.

name.note: Retains the catalog display name for the Gemini Deep Research agent preview; exact April identifier is verified.

developer.note: Official Google API documentation and Google DeepMind launch announcement.

family.note: Retains the catalog grouping because the launch explicitly names Gemini 3.1 Pro as its research backbone; this is not a standalone Pro checkpoint.

release_date.note: Exact April agent release is dated explicitly; the earlier December Deep Research release is a different identifier.

open_weights.note: Distributed as a managed Interactions API agent under service terms, without downloadable agent weights.

license.note: Proprietary hosted-service classification; not an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No agent-wide total is published in the reviewed exact-agent documentation or later model cards. Gemini 3.1 Pro component size is also undisclosed; no sibling count is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active parameter count is published for this managed agent or its named research backbone. Multi-step tool use is not a parameter count.

architecture.note: This identifier is an orchestrated agent, not one neural checkpoint. Its announced Gemini 3.1 Pro research backbone is documented as a sparse MoE Transformer through its referenced card; optional Nano Banana visualization makes that an incomplete agent-wide classification.

context_window.note: Exact agent specification lists 1,048,576 input-context tokens; this is separate from aggregate tokens consumed over a research workflow.

modalities.note: Exact agent specification supports all listed input types and cited-text/image output. Image output is an agent visualization capability.

reasoning.note: Agent plans and reasons through research, with optional intermediate reasoning summaries.

tool_call.note: Supports built-in tools and remote MCP servers. Custom function-calling tools are explicitly unsupported; the true flag describes agent tool use.

description.value: Managed research agent for autonomous multi-step investigations, synthesis, and cited reports.
description.note: Replaces the ambiguous agentic-model wording with the documented managed-agent identity.

patch.description: Managed research agent for autonomous multi-step investigations, synthesis, and cited reports.
patch.notes: Managed agent launched with Gemini 3.1 Pro, whose model card describes a sparse MoE Transformer. That backbone does not describe the entire research and visualization workflow; agent-level parameter counts are not published. Tool support includes built-in tools and remote MCP servers, but excludes custom function-calling tools.

summary: Confirmed the April 21 release, exact context limit, modalities, reasoning and agent tool use. Corrected the license to proprietary and clarified the description as a managed agent. Total/active counts remain undisclosed; standalone architecture is not applicable to this composed agent. Its Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone has documented MoE architecture, recorded separately without treating it as the entire agent. Custom function-calling tools remain unsupported.
